verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI-generated meeting notes, transcripts-to-recap, or summaries of missed meetings or huddles. The closest items are general mentions of 'Copilot Chat in Outlook and Teams' and 'Apps for Teams meetings' as a developer surface, which are adjacent features and building blocks, not the recap capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
